question: To what extent is reality composed of the mantra of Lalitā?
premises: The extent relates to the mantra of Lalitā.
Whatever consists of that is considered.
It is described as consisting of mantra.
inference: As far as the mantra of Lalitā extends, all is composed of mantra.
uncertainties: The sentence is elliptical and may continue from prior context.
plain_english: As far as the mantra of Lalitā extends, whatever consists of that is composed of mantra.
